ShortDescription.Value: Removes dummy parked vehicles across the map

Publish.LongDescription:
### What does this mod do?
- You can delete dummy parked vehicles without owners (from settings) - You can disable spawning of dummy vehicles - Bonus - You can remove abandoned trailers in the middle of the road
Mod will clear dummy parked vehicles upon loading and show you cleared amount. It is required to disable dummy traffic spawning in order to preserve clean city.
### Important
Mod incorporate logic from 2 Mimonsi mods: - [Fix Broken Trailers](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/136207/Windows) - [Dummy Traffic Remover](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/107683/Windows)
Full credits to Mimonsi for those 2 features despite my implementation is different code wise. (Mimonsi was contacted and gave me permission for this)
This mod require incorporation of logic to disable dummy traffic to be complete solution. Trailers are just bonus. You can still use those mods if you like them but that will require you to just uncheck things in Settings of this mod.
If you decide to no longer use those mods, please disable them to not have conflicts of logic.
### Support and feedback
Feedback is welcome through GitHub or Discord links on the right. If you like effort put into free mods, please give a Like :)
